title: Apply for the NSW Low Income Household Rebate (on-supply customers)
summary: Find out if you are eligible for and how to apply for the NSW Low Income Household Rebate for on-supply electricity customers.
intro:
The NSW Low Income Household Rebate helps eligible concession cardholders pay their electricity bills.

The rebate is $313.50 per embedded network (on-supply) household, per financial year.

If you're an embedded network (on supply) customer, you can apply for the rebate here.

If you're a retail (on-market) customer, contact your electricity retailer to apply.

Note: Embedded network (on-supply) means your electricity is supplied by an embedded network – such as in a residential community, retirement village or strata scheme – and you receive your electricity bill or invoice from the strata manager or community/village operator. If you’re not sure whether you're an on-supply customer, contact the electricity provider named on your electricity bill.
who_can_apply: You must have an electricity account for your home in NSW.
You must be the account holder (the account and bill must be in your name).

You must hold one of the following energy providers: ARC Energy Group, Energy Locals / Energy locals Urban, Origin Energy (including most of their WINConnect sites), or Locality Planning Energy (LPE) at specific sites.
If you receive your electricity bill from one of the specified energy providers, you should contact your retailer to apply.
what_you_need: A printed (not hand-written) copy of your latest electricity bill (JPG or PDF file) that must include your bank account details.

how_to_steps.text: Check you meet the eligibility requirements.
Follow the steps to apply for the rebate.
Download and complete the application form – NSW Low Income Household Rebate Application Form On-Supply Household – PDF.
Attach a copy of your most recent electricity bill/invoice.
Post your application to NSW Energy Rebates, PO Box 435, Parramatta NSW 2124.

more_info.text: You'll receive your rebate as a lump sum payment of $313.50 deposited into your bank account.
You can only receive the rebate for your principal place of residence.
A household can only receive one NSW Low Income Household Rebate each financial year.
If you receive the NSW Low Income Household Rebate, you may be eligible for the NSW Gas Rebate.
Commonwealth Seniors Health Card holders are not eligible for this rebate and can apply for the Seniors Energy Rebate instead.

faqs.q: How much is the NSW Low Income Household Rebate?
faqs.a: The rebate is $313.50 per embedded network (on-supply) household, per financial year.

faqs.q: Who can apply for this rebate?
faqs.a: You must have an electricity account for your home in NSW, be the account holder, and hold one of the listed energy providers.

faqs.q: What do I need to apply for the rebate?
faqs.a: You need your concession card details and a printed copy of your latest electricity bill (JPG or PDF file) that includes your bank account details.
